```{r setup, include=FALSE,message=FALSE,echo=FALSE,warning=FALSE}
    ngs_qc_data  = dbGetQuery(dbCon, sprintf("SELECT * FROM qc_report WHERE BatchID = '%s'", BatchID))

    dbDisconnect(dbCon)

    dbCon = dbConnect(dbDriver("MySQL"), host='192.168.0.34', user='gcx', port=3306, password='gencurix!!', db='gcx_ngs_service' )
    sinfo = dbGetQuery(dbCon, sprintf("SELECT * FROM seqid_info WHERE seq_folder = '%s'", BatchID))
    pinfo = dbGetQuery(dbCon, sprintf("SELECT * FROM seqfolder_info WHERE seq_folder = '%s'", BatchID))

    GT_DefaultForm <- function(gt_tbl) {
        gt_tbl |> tab_style(
            style     = cell_text( weight = "bold", font="Roboto", size=px(11) ),
            locations = cells_column_labels( everything() )
        ) |> tab_style(
            style     = cell_text( font="Roboto Condensed", size=px(10) ),
            locations = cells_body()
        ) |> cols_align( 
            align = "center", columns = everything()
        ) |> tab_options(
            table.width                    = pct(100),
            data_row.padding               = px(4),
            heading.title.font.size        = px(11),
            heading.subtitle.font.size     = px(11),
            table.border.top.style         = "none",
            column_labels.border.top.style = "none",
            heading.border.bottom.style    = "none"
        )
    }
    GT_BoBorderForm <- function(gt_tbl){
        gt_tbl |> tab_options(
            table.width                       = pct(100),
            table.font.names                  = "Roboto",
            table.font.size                   = px(11),
            data_row.padding                  = px(5),
            table.border.top.style            = "none",
            table.border.bottom.style         = "none",
            table_body.border.top.style       = "none",
            table_body.border.bottom.style    = "none",
            table_body.hlines.style           = "none",
            table_body.vlines.style           = "none",
            column_labels.border.top.style    = "none",
            column_labels.border.bottom.style = "none",
            column_labels.hidden              = TRUE,
            row_group.border.top.style        = "none",
            row_group.border.bottom.style     = "none"
            
        )
    }    

    gt_theme1 <- function(gt_tbl) {
        gt_tbl |> tab_options(
            table.font.names = c("Roboto"),
            table.font.size = px(11),
            data_row.padding = px(4),
            column_labels.font.size = px(11),
            heading.title.font.size = px(11),
            heading.subtitle.font.size = px(11)
        )
    }
    gt_no_borders <- function(gt_tbl){
        gt_tbl |> tab_options(
            table.border.top.style = "none",
            table.border.bottom.style = "none",
            table_body.border.top.style = "none",
            table_body.border.bottom.style = "none",
            table_body.hlines.style = "none",
            table_body.vlines.style = "none",
            column_labels.border.top.style = "none",
            column_labels.border.bottom.style = "none",
            row_group.border.top.style = "none",
            row_group.border.bottom.style = "none"
        )
    }    
    NGS_report.Page.Breaks2 <- function(){
        cat('<div style="page-break-after: always;"></div>')
        cat('<br>')
    }
```

```{r order_info, message=FALSE,echo=FALSE,warning=FALSE,results='asis'}
    # select late date
    report_date_list <- sinfo %>% summarise(
        date_sample_in  = max(as.Date(date_sample_in,  format = "%Y%m%d"), na.rm = TRUE),
        date_sample_qc  = max(as.Date(date_sample_qc,  format = "%Y%m%d"), na.rm = TRUE)
    )
    # output table
    order_info_output_table <- rbind(
        c("CLIENT INSTITUTE",       " ", pinfo$client_name ),
        c(" "," "," "),
        c("TOTAL SAMPLES",          " ", nrow(sinfo)       ),
        c(" "," "," "),
        c("DATE OF SAMPLE RECEIPT", " ", report_date_list["date_sample_in"] ),
        c(" "," "," "),
        c("DATE OF SAMPLE QC",      " ", report_date_list["date_sample_qc"] ),
        c(" "," "," "),
        c("DATE OF NGS REPORT",     " ", REPORT_DATE ),
        c(" "," "," "),
        c("ORDER ID",               " ", OrderID ),
        c(" "," "," "),
        c("ANALYSIS INSTITUTE",     " ", "GENCURIX Inc." )
    ) %>% as.data.frame() %>% setNames( paste0("c", 1:ncol(.)) ) %>% gt() |> GT_BoBorderForm() |>
        cols_label( c1 = "", c2 = "", c3 = "" ) |>
        cols_width( c1 ~ pct(30), c2 ~ pct(3), c3 ~ pct(67) ) |>
        tab_style( style = cell_text(weight = "bold"), locations = cells_body(columns = c1) ) |>
        cols_align( align = "center", columns = 1 ) |>
        cols_align( align = "left",   columns = 3 )

    #---/ OUTPUT 
    print( order_info_output_table )
```

<!-- FINDINGS SUMMARY  -->

```{r find_summary, message=FALSE,echo=FALSE,warning=FALSE,results='asis'}
    # found driver mutations
    DRV_MUT = data.frame()
    for( j in 1:nrow(hmf_var_stat) ){
        sample_name = sinfo %>% filter( seq_id == hmf_var_stat[j, "SeqID"] ) %>% .$sample_name
        if( hmf_var_stat[j, "driver_mutations"] > 0 ){
            if( hmf_var_stat[j, "drivder_mutations_highconf"] > 0 ) {
                DrvMutFinding <- sprintf(
                    "%s driver mutations found, including %s high-confidence mutations.", 
                    hmf_var_stat[j, "driver_mutations"], hmf_var_stat[j, "drivder_mutations_highconf"]
                ) 
            }else{
                DrvMutFinding <- sprintf("%s driver mutations found.", hmf_var_stat[j, "driver_mutations"])
            }
        }else{
            DrvMutFinding <- "No driver mutations found."
        }
        DRV_MUT = rbind( 
            DRV_MUT, 
            data.frame(c1=" ", c2=" ", c3=" ", c4="  " ),
            data.frame(c1=" ", c2=sample_name, c3=" ", c4=DrvMutFinding ) 
        )
    }
    # found driver cnvs
    DRV_CNV = data.frame()
    for( j in 1:nrow(hmf_var_stat) ){
        sample_name = sinfo %>% filter( seq_id == hmf_var_stat[j, "SeqID"] ) %>% .$sample_name
        if( hmf_var_stat[j, "driver_cnv"] > 0 ){
            DrvCnvFinding <- sprintf("%s driver CNVs found.", hmf_var_stat[j, "driver_cnv"]) 
        }else{
            DrvCnvFinding <- "No driver CNVs found."
        }
        DRV_CNV = rbind( 
            DRV_CNV, 
            data.frame(c1=" ", c2=" ", c3=" ", c4="  " ),
            data.frame(c1=" ", c2=sample_name, c3=" ", c4=DrvCnvFinding ) 
        )
    }
    # found sv
    SV_FOUND = data.frame()
    for( j in 1:nrow(hmf_var_stat) ){
        sample_name = sinfo %>% filter( seq_id == hmf_var_stat[j, "SeqID"] ) %>% .$sample_name
        if( hmf_var_stat[j, "sv_found"] > 0 ){
            SvFinding <- sprintf("%s SV found.", hmf_var_stat[j, "sv_found"]) 
        }else{
            SvFinding <- "No SV found."
        }
        SV_FOUND = rbind( 
            SV_FOUND, 
            data.frame(c1=" ", c2=" ", c3=" ", c4="  " ),
            data.frame(c1=" ", c2=sample_name, c3=" ", c4=SvFinding ) 
        )
    }

    # driver mutations output
    DriveMutations_OUT <- DRV_MUT %>% gt() |> GT_BoBorderForm() |> 
        cols_label( c1="", c2="", c3="", c4="" ) |>
        cols_width( c1 ~ pct(8), c2 ~ pct(20), c3 ~ pct(2), c4 ~ pct(70) ) 
    # driver cnvs output
    DriverCnvs_OUT <- DRV_CNV %>% gt() |> GT_BoBorderForm() |> 
        cols_label( c1="", c2="", c3="", c4="" ) |>
        cols_width( c1 ~ pct(8), c2 ~ pct(20), c3 ~ pct(2), c4 ~ pct(70) ) 
    # sv output
    SV_OUT <- SV_FOUND %>% gt() |> GT_BoBorderForm() |> 
        cols_label( c1="", c2="", c3="", c4="" ) |>
        cols_width( c1 ~ pct(8), c2 ~ pct(20), c3 ~ pct(2), c4 ~ pct(70) ) 

    #---/ OUTPUT
    space3="&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;"
    # driver mutations
    cat(sprintf('<div style="color: #000000; font-size: 14px; font-weight: bold;"> %s Driver Mutations </div>', space3))
    cat('<hr style="border: solid 1px #cccccc; margin-top: 8px; margin-bottom: 8px;">')
    print(DriveMutations_OUT)
    cat('<br>')
    # driver cnvs
    cat(sprintf('<div style="color: #000000; font-size: 14px; font-weight: bold;"> %s Driver CNVs </div>', space3))
    cat('<hr style="border: solid 1px #cccccc; margin-top: 8px; margin-bottom: 8px;">')
    print(DriverCnvs_OUT)
    cat('<br>')
    # sv
    cat(sprintf('<div style="color: #000000; font-size: 14px; font-weight: bold;"> %s Structural Variants </div>', space3))
    cat('<hr style="border: solid 1px #cccccc; margin-top: 8px; margin-bottom: 8px;">')
    print(SV_OUT)
    #---/ page breaks 
    NGS_report.Page.Breaks2()
```

```{r var_stats, message=FALSE,echo=FALSE,warning=FALSE,results='asis'}
    # output table
    var_num_stats_output_table <- hmf_var_stat %>% mutate( 
        SeqID = sinfo[match(SeqID, sinfo$seq_id), "sample_name"]
    ) %>% dplyr::select( !c("BatchID") ) %>% setNames( 
        paste0("c", 1:ncol(.)) 
    ) %>% gt() |> GT_DefaultForm() |> cols_label( 
        c1='SAMPLE NAME', c2='UNFILTERED', c3='FILTERED', c4='DRIVER', c5='HIGH-CONF DRIVER', 
        c6='AMPLIFICATION', c7="DELETION", c8="DRIVER CNV", c9="SV"
    ) |> tab_spanner( id="muts", columns=2:5, label = "SOMATIC VARIANTS" 
    ) |> tab_style( 
        style     = cell_text( font="Roboto", size=px(11), weight = "bold" ),
        locations = cells_column_spanners(spanners = "muts")
    ) |> tab_spanner( id="cnvs", columns = 6:8, label = "COPY-NUMBER ALTERATIONS"
    ) |> tab_style(
        style     = cell_text( font="Roboto", size=px(11), weight = "bold" ),
        locations = cells_column_spanners(spanners = "cnvs")
    ) |> cols_width( 1 ~ pct(20), 9 ~ pct(5) )  
    
    #---/ OUTPUT-1
    cat(sprintf('<div style="color: #000000; font-size: 14px; font-weight: bold;"> %s </div>', "Variants Stats"))
    cat('<hr style="border: solid 1px #d6d6d6; margin-top: 5px; margin-bottom: 7px;">')
    print(var_num_stats_output_table)
    cat('<br>')
    cat('<br>')

    cat(sprintf('<div style="color: #000000; font-size: 14px; font-weight: bold;"> %s </div>', "Mutation Class"))
    cat('<hr style="border: solid 1px #d6d6d6; margin-top: 5px; margin-bottom: 7px;">')
    SIDS <- unique(hmf_varclass$SeqID)
    for( j in 1:length(SIDS))
    {
        vc <- hmf_varclass %>% filter( SeqID == SIDS[j]) %>% dplyr::select(c(3:5)) %>% tidyr::pivot_longer(
            cols      = c(unfiltered, somatic_filtered),
            names_to  = "filter_type",
            values_to = "count"
        ) %>% tidyr::pivot_wider(
            names_from  = variant_class,
            values_from = count
        ) %>% mutate( filter_type = c("Unfiltered","Filtered") ) %>% as.data.frame() %>% setNames(
            paste0("c", c(1:18))
        ) %>% gt() |> GT_DefaultForm() |> cols_label( 
            c1="", c2="Missense", c3="Nonsense", c4="DEL",c5="INS", c6="DEL", c7="INS", c8="Region", c9="Site", c10="Intron",
            c11="5'", c12="3'", c13="Silent", c14="IGR", c15="5'",c16="3'",c17="RNA", c18="Targeted Region" 
        ) |> tab_spanner( id = "frameshift", columns = 4:5,   label = "FrameShift"
        ) |> tab_spanner( id = "inframe",    columns = 6:7,   label = "InFrame"
        ) |> tab_spanner( id = "splice",     columns = 8:9,   label = "Splice"
        ) |> tab_spanner( id = "utr",        columns = 11:12, label = "UTR"
        ) |> tab_spanner( id = "flank",      columns = 15:16, label = "Flank"
        ) |> tab_style( style = cell_text( weight = "bold", size=px(11) ), locations = cells_column_spanners(everything() ) 
        ) |> tab_style( style = cell_text( weight = "bold", size=px(11) ), locations = cells_body( rows = 2, columns = 2:9 )
        ) |> tab_style( style = cell_text( weight = "bold", size=px(10) ), locations = cells_column_labels(everything() )
        ) |> cols_align( align = "center", columns = everything() )

        SN = sinfo %>% filter( seq_id == SIDS[j] ) %>% .$sample_name
        
        #---/ OUTPUT-2
        cat('<br>')
        cat(sprintf('<div style="color: #000000; font-size: 12px; font-weight: bold;"> %s </div>', SN))
        print(vc)
        
    }
    #---/ page breaks 
    NGS_report.Page.Breaks2()
```

<!-- DRIVER MUTATIONS -->

```{r drv_mut, message=FALSE,echo=FALSE,warning=FALSE,results='asis'}
    
    cat(sprintf('<div style="color: #000000; font-size: 14px; font-weight: bold;"> %s </div>', "Driver Mutations"))
    cat('<hr style="border: solid 1px #d6d6d6; margin-top: 5px; margin-bottom: 7px;">')
    cat('<br>')

    SIDS <- unique(hmf_drvmut$SeqID)
    for( j in 1:length(SIDS))
    {
        hc <- hmf_drvmut %>% filter( SeqID == SIDS[j] )
        dm <- hmf_drvmut %>% filter( SeqID == SIDS[j] ) %>% mutate( varpos=paste0(chrom,":",pos) ) %>% dplyr::select(
            c("gene","varpos","ref","alt","hgvsp","vaf","HighConf","driverLikelihood","category","clonality")
        ) %>% setNames(paste0("c", c(1:10))) %>% gt() |> GT_DefaultForm() |> cols_label( 
            c1="GENE", c2="POSITION", c3="REF", c4="ALT",c5="HGVSp", c6="VAF", 
            c7="HIGH CONFIDENCE", c8="DRIVER LIKELIHOOD",c9="DRIVER TYPE", c10="CLONALITY"
        ) |> tab_style(
            style     = cell_text( size = px(10), color = "#C73500", font = "Roboto Condensed" ),
            locations = cells_body( rows = which(as.logical(hc$HighConf)), columns = everything() )
        ) 
        SN = sinfo %>% filter( seq_id == SIDS[j] ) %>% .$sample_name
        #---/ OUTPUT
        cat('<br>')
        cat(sprintf('<div style="color: #000000; font-size: 12px; font-weight: bold;"> %s </div>', SN))
        print(dm)
    } 
    #---/ page breaks
    NGS_report.Page.Breaks2()
```

## III. Somatic Mutation Filters
- FILTER = "PASS"
- ALT Reads >= 2 
- Depth >= 10
- Variant Class Included in 
    - Missense, Nonsense, Frameshift-DEL/INS, InFrame-DEL/INS, Splice-Region/Site

<br>

## IV. Copy Number Alterations Filter
- Amplification : Max. CN >= Ploidy * 3
- Deletion : Min. CN < 0.5 and Max. CN < 1 

<br>
